comment: Per Vulkan member (or GL extension): can the hardware do it honestly, only emulated, or not at all; the lane-day cost of the emulation; what it unlocks; which D3D level it gates; which of the owner's games it blocks. Every entry names the note it comes from — the generator does not invent a class. A member with no entry is printed with class `unknown` and a `?` status: that is the signal to fill it, not a guess.

geometryShader.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 1 (Valhall has no GS; Arm's GLES driver expands VS->primitives on the same GPU)

shaderCullDistance.unlocks: ARB_cull_distance -> wined3d SM5; DXVK device creation
shaderCullDistance.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 2 (nir_lower_clip_cull_distance to varyings + FS discard)

robustBufferAccess2.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 3 (robust_access lowering already compiled in)

descriptorIndexing.unlocks: DXVK/vkd3d device creation with bindless-ish resources
descriptorIndexing.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 5 (non-uniform lowering exists in vk/src/mali_descriptor_lower.c)

maxComputeWorkGroupInvocations.note: notes/feature-level.md row 10; PanVK oracle reports 1024 on the same chips

transformFeedbackQueries.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §B row 1 (no HW XFB counters; count primitives in the emulation path)

storageTexelBufferOffsetSingleTexelAlign.note: notes/route-decision-2.md §B row 2 (round down, compensate in the shader)

drawIndirectCount.unlocks: the geometryShader emulation's second pass, DXVK optional

bufferDeviceAddress.note: vk/R4-GAP.md §3 vk12 row (kbase GPU VA = host VA mapping)

icd-txf-combined-sampler.unlocks: every consumer that texelFetches a combined image sampler (zink's blit)

icd-view-format-target.unlocks: mutable-format sRGB window views (zink presents this way)
